> Last curated: **2026-07-23**

This list uses **4DGS** broadly: native 4D Gaussian primitives, deformable or time-conditioned 3D
Gaussians, explicit Gaussian trajectories or sequences, and closely related dynamic Gaussian
representations. Of 347 listed arXiv papers, 325 are direct dynamic-Gaussian works, two are
supporting resources, and 20 are clearly labeled adjacent or historical references.

Every row includes a concise **Focus** summary grounded in the reviewed contribution metadata.
Paper titles link to arXiv. A blank **Code** cell means no usable public implementation was
verified; placeholder repositories and "coming soon" announcements are not listed as code.
Focused sections intentionally repeat papers when that makes a section useful on its own.

## Reading guide

| If you are looking for... | Start with | What it covers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Dynamic reconstruction and rendering | [Core 4DGS](#core-4dgs-and-dynamic-scene-rendering) | Per-scene reconstruction, native spacetime primitives, deformation, compression, streaming, editing, and simulation |
| Generalizable inference | [Feed-forward 4DGS](#feed-forward-4dgs) | Methods that predict dynamic Gaussian representations without optimizing every scene from scratch |
| Motion and scene understanding | [Tracking, segmentation, and SLAM](#dynamic-tracking-segmentation-and-slam) | Persistent tracking, scene flow, segmentation, camera tracking, and dynamic mapping |
| People and articulated subjects | [Dynamic humans and avatars](#dynamic-humans-and-avatars) | Bodies, heads, hands, relighting, animation, and human-object interaction |
| Evaluation data | [Datasets](#datasets) | Monocular and multi-view scenes, humans, long sequences, driving, and physics-aware benchmarks |

Representation tags distinguish several common designs: `deformable-3dgs` uses canonical 3D
Gaussians with time-dependent deformation; `native-4dgs` gives primitives explicit spacetime
support; `explicit` stores trajectories, frames, or temporal bases directly; and `feed-forward`
predicts a representation without per-scene optimization. These tags overlap and describe design
choices rather than mutually exclusive paper families.

## Feed-forward 4DGS

Methods that reconstruct, generate, encode, or compress a dynamic Gaussian representation in a
learned forward pass, rather than optimizing a new representation from scratch for every sequence.

## Dynamic tracking, segmentation, and SLAM

dynamics-aware mapping. Some reconstruction papers are repeated because tracking is a primary
output of the method.

## Dynamic humans and avatars

This section includes dynamic-human reconstruction and animatable Gaussian avatars. These works
may use articulated or mesh-anchored 3D Gaussians instead of a native 4D Gaussian primitive, but
they represent appearance over time and are part of the wider 4DGS ecosystem.

| 2023 | [ASH: Animatable Gaussian Splats for Efficient and Photoreal Human Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.05941)<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; per-scene &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; real-time</sub> | Attaches animatable Gaussians to a deformable character model for controllable, photorealistic rendering of clothed humans. | [Project](https://vcai.mpi-inf.mpg.de/projects/ash/) | [GitHub](https://github.com/kv2000/ASH) |
| 2023 | [HiFi4G: High-Fidelity Human Performance Rendering via Compact Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.03461)<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; compression &middot; tracking &middot; native-4dgs</sub> | Combines Gaussian splatting with non-rigid tracking through a coarse deformation graph and fine Gaussian graph. | [Project](https://nowheretrix.github.io/HiFi4G/) |  |
| 2023 | [GauHuman: Articulated Gaussian Splatting from Monocular Human Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.02973)<br><sub>avatar &middot; human &middot; monocular &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; fast-training &middot; real-time</sub> | Transforms canonical Gaussians into posed space with linear blend skinning while jointly refining pose and skinning weights. | [Project](https://skhu101.github.io/GauHuman/) | [GitHub](https://github.com/skhu101/GauHuman) |
| 2023 | [HeadGaS: Real-Time Animatable Head Avatars via 3D Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.02902)<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; per-scene &middot; hybrid &middot; real-time</sub> | Builds an animatable head avatar by augmenting explicit 3D Gaussian splats with a learned latent feature basis. |  |  |
| 2023 | [GaussianAvatar: Towards Realistic Human Avatar Modeling from a Single Video via Animatable 3D Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.02134)<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; per-scene &middot; explicit</sub> | Introduces animatable explicit 3D Gaussians for human appearance across poses and clothing styles from a single video. | [Project](https://huliangxiao.github.io/GaussianAvatar) | [GitHub](https://github.com/aipixel/GaussianAvatar) |
| 2023 | [GaussianAvatars: Photorealistic Head Avatars with Rigged 3D Gaussians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.02069)<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; explicit &middot; real-time</sub> | Rigs dynamic 3D Gaussian splats to a parametric morphable face model for controllable pose and expression animation. | [Project](https://shenhanqian.github.io/gaussian-avatars) | [GitHub](https://github.com/ShenhanQian/GaussianAvatars) |
| 2023 | [HUGS: Human Gaussian Splats](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.17910)<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; fast-training &middot; real-time</sub> | Learns a static scene and fully animatable human avatar from a short monocular video using 3D Gaussian splatting. | [Project](https://machinelearning.apple.com/research/hugs) | [GitHub](https://github.com/apple/ml-hugs) |
| 2023 | [Human Gaussian Splatting: Real-time Rendering of Animatable Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.17113)<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; real-time &middot; per-scene</sub> | Represents the human body with canonical-space Gaussians learned end-to-end from multi-view observations. | [Project](https://perezpellitero.github.io/projects/hugs/) |  |
| 2023 | [GART: Gaussian Articulated Template Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.16099)<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; deformable-3dgs &middot; fast-training &middot; real-time</sub> | Uses a mixture of moving 3D Gaussians to explicitly model articulated, non-rigid subjects from monocular video. | [Project](https://jiahuilei.com/projects/gart/) | [GitHub](https://github.com/JiahuiLei/GART) |
| 2023 | [Animatable and Relightable Gaussians for High-fidelity Human Avatar Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.16096)<br><sub>avatar &middot; multi-view &middot; human &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; relighting &middot; deformable-3dgs</sub> | Parameterizes an animatable template with front and back canonical Gaussian maps, allowing CNN-based pose-dependent appearance prediction. | [Project](https://animatable-gaussians.github.io/) | [GitHub](https://github.com/lizhe00/AnimatableGaussians) |
| 2023 | [SplatArmor: Articulated Gaussian splatting for animatable humans from monocular RGB videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.10812)<br><sub>avatar &middot; monocular &middot; human &middot; per-scene &middot; mesh-anchored &middot; deformable-3dgs</sub> | Represents a human with canonical 3D Gaussians whose articulation extends SMPL forward skinning to arbitrary canonical-space locations. | [Project](https://jenaroh.it/splatarmor/) |  |

## Datasets

normalized across common aliases; **Data / Project** points to an official source when one is
available.
